Product contact #4, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Ribbon blender P1-301, built in house, rev B
6 cu ft working, 131 L / 67 kg batch, 40 rpm, 1.5 kW, 230 V 1-ph, 316L product contact, bolted free end for agitator removal
dry seasoning blends, Phase 1 line (1,000 lb/week), 1 batch per 20-30 min
R280 inside x 900 long, 3 mm 316L, #4 inside
double ribbon: outer Ø550 / inner Ø320, pitches 600 / 450; 14 arms
PTFE packing 4 x 10 sq in stuffing boxes; bearings outboard
NORD helical-bevel hollow-shaft gearmotor 1.5 kW on a torque arm; VFD GS21 with STO
4 in sanitary butterfly valve, 24 V actuator, bottom centre
cover interlock + E-stop, PNOZ s4, PL d target
axis 1,683; flange top 1,983; valve outlet 1,261; upstand top 2,014 [79.3 in]
P1-301 RIBBON BLENDER 6 CU FT: DRAWING SET
SECTION A-A, SEAL AND BEARING DETAIL, SECTION B-B
FREE END: SHELL RING, BOLTED END PLATE, GASKET
ELECTRICAL: WIRES, TERMINALS, CABLES, VFD SETTINGS
INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
1. Units mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Tolerances in the title block unless noted. Weld symbols AWS A2.4; welding GTAW ER316L per AWS D1.6.
2. Product-contact surfaces #4, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin], welds ground flush and blended, no crevices; passivate ASTM A967 after all welding.
3. Cut files (DXF, mm and inch) are in dxf/; 3D models (STEP per part, assembly STEP/GLB) in cad/; generators: design.py, model.py, sh_*.py.
4. Bought parts marked 'confirm' must be checked against the supplier drawing before the related made part is cut (NORD bore and torque arm, latch, enclosure foot kit).
5. Release for build: drawings checked, ITP P1-301-900 attached to the traveler, materials certified.
